message: I was packing our go-bags the other day, and I realized how much I rely on my phone for everything—directions, contacts, even grocery lists. Just as I was about to double-check our emergency plan, my phone died! Talk about a wake-up call. It made me think about how important it is to have printed copies of key documents and plans, just in case technology decides to take a nap. Have you ever had a tech hiccup that made you rethink your preparedness? 🌟
